note: Fixed layout values per role. CSS px, 1280x795 window. "variants" preserves every distinct observed rectangle and spacing combination, including different positions at equal size. Each variant lists rect (x, y, width, height), padding (top right bottom left), gap (row, column), border widths (top right bottom left), font size, line height, display, position, and only the pack frames in which that exact combination was observed (empty when no frame does). "class" is fixed, intrinsic-width or flow. Rule and shadow strength, radius and colour are paint and are not here.

tolerance.fixed: 0.5 px (check C2), about 2 px against a build (completion rule)
tolerance.intrinsic-width: height equal, width within 8 px or 4 percent, whichever is larger
tolerance.flow: no overflow or overlap; line height equal
